description: Paid ($0.05 USD). Bundle: what is moving the XRP market today, in one call and one payment. Market posture and headline, whale count (1M+ XRP wallets) and its change, exchange net flow, entity positioning, Ripple escrow calendar, XRP fund holdings (XR-Flows) and on-ledger sell impact for $1M, $10M and $100M (XR-Telemetry). Returns summary, key_numbers and sections; each section says ok, stale or unreadable.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to return: briefing, whales, exchange_net_flow, entity_positioning, escrow_calendar, fund_holdings, liquidity. Omit for all. summary and key_numbers always come back.

name: xrpl_xrp_market_briefing
